_README: Reserved devices for this account — the radios you have been allocated.
MANUALLY maintained: the testbed's reservation feed does not populate this
yet, so copy this file to /workspace/experiments/settings/reservation.json
and fill in your radios. Update reserved_local whenever you edit it.
This is the TOP of the PHY pipeline:
-> prepare.sh --args <rx addr/serial>   surveys the RECEIVER, picks the carrier
-> calibration.sh --plan                reads the rx/tx serials from here
-> radio.sh / run.sh                    read the finished profile.
Unlike the GENERATED <node>.json inventory in this folder (what each session
actually sees), this file is AUTHORED: it says what SHOULD be here — which is
how the TX radio, never surveyed, gets named at all. Match a device by its
serial (stable) or addr; role is rx (the one that gets surveyed) or tx.
reserved_local: 2026-09-02 20:00:00 EDT   <- set to when you last edited this

devices.addr: <rx network radio IP, e.g. 192.168.30.2, or null for USB>

devices.note: transmitter — never surveyed (a receive-only survey says nothing about a TX)
